MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink doorbell feels like a useful addition because front-door alerts connect my earlier interest in a door alarm with the Alexa devices I already use.",
    "The memory card connects with my past storage purchases and card reader, although I would need a reason to choose that much capacity and speed.",
    "The larger Echo Show and Alexa-compatible cameras connect with my interests, but they are possibilities to consider later rather than things I need immediately."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Older Echo Dot and Show 5 models offer little reason to buy when I recently purchased newer versions and a stand for my Show 5.",
    "Both Fire TV Stick recommendations repeat a need already covered by my recent 4K Max bundle.",
    "The Ring charging station requires battery devices I have not shown any sign of owning, so it lacks a clear purpose for me."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to be treated as interest in almost any Alexa device, even when it duplicates something I already have.",
    "Interest in home electronics seems to carry too far into car accessories and multi-camera setups without evidence that I need them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter: buying a newer device usually reduces my immediate interest in an older device serving the same purpose.",
    "A useful addition matters more than a familiar product name; the doorbell adds a function, while another streaming stick repeats one.",
    "My interest can be conditional: I would check storage requirements before buying the card and try a doorbell before committing to three indoor cameras."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in Alexa and practical electronics, but miss the difference between adding a useful capability and repeating a recent purchase."
}
